patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — MailerLite and Omnisend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

MailerLite and Omnisend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose MailerLite only if your buying job matches “Simple email marketing for SMBs and creators with a free tier and approachable Comfort/Pow” rather than Omnisend's shape. Choose Omnisend only if your buying job matches “Ecommerce multichannel email, SMS, and web push with Shopify-centric automation — a common” rather than MailerLite's shape. Workflow advantage differs because MailerLite is shaped for Simple email marketing for SMBs and creators with a free tier and appr whereas Omnisend is shaped for Ecommerce multichannel email, SMS, and web push with Shopify-centric a. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — MailerLite and Omnisend share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: MailerLite is Simple email marketing for SMBs and creators with a free tier and approachable Comfort/Power subscriber plans.; Omnisend is Ecommerce multichannel email, SMS, and web push with Shopify-centric automation — a common Klaviyo alternative..
- Company-size focus: MailerLite (micro, small-business) vs Omnisend (small-business, mid-market).
- Researched limits: MailerLite — Free caps at 250 subscribers / 2,500 emails per 30 days; Omnisend — Standard email send caps scale with contacts — heavy senders may need Pro.

Limitations — MailerLite: Free caps at 250 subscribers / 2,500 emails per 30 days; Automation and segmentation depth trail Klaviyo and ActiveCampaign; Omnisend: Standard email send caps scale with contacts — heavy senders may need Pro; Live intro discounts complicate quoting non-promo monthly floors.

Poor-fit cases: MailerLite is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Free caps at 250 subscribers / 2,500 emails per 30 days · Omnisend is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Standard email send caps scale with contacts — heavy senders may need Pro · Avoid MailerLite if you actually need Omnisend's motion (Ecommerce multichannel email, SMS, and web push with Shopify-centric automation )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
